text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. As per conditions of approval for the development at 4841 to 4881 Yonge Street, 2 and 50 Sheppard Avenue East, and 2, 4 and 6 Forest Laneway, a pedestrian crossover (PXO) is to be installed on Greenfield Avenue, approximately 120 metres west of Doris Avenue, with the cost associated with the installation of the PXO to be shared by the City and the proponent. Transportation Services can support the installation of a PXO on Greenfield Avenue, approximately 120 metres west of Doris Avenue, as it will provide enhanced safety for vulnerable road users and is justified based on the assessment undertaken.
North York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of a pedestrian crossover on Greenfield Avenue at a point approximately 120 metres west of Doris Avenue.
